description: This file contains the implementation of the Bootstrap affix plugin (version 3.3.7), defining the Affix class, its methods, and plugin initialization code for affix behavior in web pages.

classes.name: Affix
classes.description: Class implementing the affix behavior, managing element position based on scroll and offset options.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Determines the current affix state ('top', 'bottom', or false) based on scroll position and offsets.

methods.name: getPinnedOffset
methods.description: Calculates and caches the offset when the element is affixed at the top.

methods.name: checkPositionWithEventLoop
methods.description: Schedules a position check after a short delay to avoid layout thrashing.

methods.name: checkPosition
methods.description: Checks and updates the affix state of the element based on current scroll position and offsets.
